description: Find Wisty UI items by the job they do, best first. Each match gives its name, kind (primitive, component, block, helper) and description. A block is a finished section built from components and primitives over sample data, to install and edit: when the job is a whole section, start from its block, not its parts. Read a match with get_component.

query.description: One to three keywords for the job, like "record picker", "picklist" or "confirm delete", not a sentence.

name: search_components
title: Search Wisty UI
